text: Explore a mutually useful AI-automation collaboration with Robin through one real Leipzig delivery
description: On the scheduled weekend call (1–2 August 2026), Felix begins from appreciation for Robin's existing real-economy AI-automation work in Leipzig and asks whether Robin would like Aimparency/Felix connected to it. Do not treat Robin as a source of contracts or access. Explore whether there is excess demand, bounded subcontractable work, or a delivery where collaboration would genuinely help Robin and the client. Start with automation customers already value; introduce greater agent autonomy only where the client authorizes it and economics justify it. If a concrete opportunity exists, clarify the client problem, scope, decision-maker, budget, deadline, data/credential boundaries, Robin/Felix roles, commercial arrangement, and reusable learning. Success is a mutually welcomed paid or explicitly budgeted next step—not extraction from the relationship or general encouragement.

status.comment: Call with Robin is scheduled for the weekend of 1–2 August 2026. Felix must ask for a concrete overflow/subcontracting opportunity and agree roles/commercial boundaries; the agent can prepare, scope, implement, and verify authorized work afterward.
